universe.note: 거래일 16:00 ka00198 당일누적 상위 20 ∪ ka10032 거래대금 상위 30 (중복 제거), 코스피/코스닥만. 매차 최소금액으로 1주 이상. 다음 거래일 관리종목(MTS01)·관심 USE_TRADE=Y. 매일 전량 교체, 원장 미청산 유지. 양봉 필터 없음. 장중 신규 편입 없음.

rules.entry: from above touch SMA20 once; do not buy on touch; same-day only: wait for a 3-min bar that closes bullish above SMA20 (close>open and close>SMA20); place a limit buy at the SMA20 nearby tick; if unfilled after 10 minutes cancel remainder (no market follow-up); wait expires same day; retouch resets; 14:00 cutoff only if next calendar day is closed; after full exit ban rebuy that stock same day
rules.halfTp: pnl>=tp1Pct sell tp1QtyRatio of holdings; then pnl>=tp2Pct sell tp2QtyRatio of remaining; after 2nd, remaining +tp3Pct sells tp3QtyRatio; then remaining +tp4Pct flattens; every day from 15:15, if 0%<=pnl<=3% flatten all remaining (keep losses and pnl>3%) | if remaining qty is 1, any reached TP step flattens 100% (no ratio); after tp1 with qty=1 allow trail/tp4 without tp2Taken
rules.afterHalf: after 1st or 2nd TP, remaining flattens at avg -afterHalfStopPct (0=breakeven); after 2nd, remaining +tp3Pct sells half then +tp4Pct flattens; after 3rd (residual): if peak>=afterHalfTrailMinPct and pnl<=peak-afterHalfTrailTpPct flatten residual (trail); else +tp4Pct flatten; trail and tp4 whichever first
rules.stop: before any TP: hard -2%; after 1st or 2nd TP: avg 0% (breakeven) flatten remaining; same-day entry flatten after 15:18 if px<=avg; prior-day SMA20 after 15:18
rules.takeProfit: intraday: 1st +1.2% sell 30%; 2nd +2% sell 30%; 3rd +4% sell 50% of remaining; 4th +7% flatten remaining; also profit (px>avg) and RSI14>=rsiTpMin flatten all remaining
